entries.text: Running node -- .qa/checks/mail-evidence.mjs missing-code retains the message's authentication results and inbox placement in message.json when the requested one-time code is absent.
Running node -- .qa/checks/mail-evidence.mjs missing-code leaves the criterion unverified with a reason naming the missing one-time code.
Running node -- .qa/checks/mail-evidence.mjs quoted-auth preserves whitespace around equals signs inside quoted Authentication-Results values.
